label: Syntactic glue in running text
explanation: Fires on the structural glue of well-formed text — punctuation, coordinators, copulas/auxiliaries, and light verb-phrase material — typically in runs spanning a clause's predicate core ("is not provided by", "will decrease as well."), including list commas and code punctuation. It is gated by context and position rather than token identity: silent at sequence starts, strengthening deeper into sequences, with subject nouns like "memory"/"pressure" (~11%) the best preceding triggers and no fired-on token exceeding 3% conditional rate. It does not fire on most lexical content words.
